task: Hard falsification of classwise nonexplosion/positive recurrence for finite time-homogeneous integer mass-action endotactic networks
overall_status: All-endotactic classwise claim refuted by a published strongly endotactic explosive class; new finite-cap arithmetic is internally reconstructed and externally unreviewed.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For the finite diagram 0->2A->4A+B->6A+4B->3A with any fixed positive time-homogeneous rate constants and stochastic mass-action propensities kappa_r x_under_y, Gamma={(a,b) in N0^2:a>=3} is a closed irreducible class. From every state in Gamma the minimal CTMC explodes with positive probability.
claims.proof_path: FINAL_REPORT.md: the closure/irreducibility proof gives enabled pump and decrement macros; the infinite prescribed cycle from (n,0) has factors p1_n,p2_n,p3_n=1-O(n^-2), while conditional holding-time means sum as O(n^-2+n^-4+n^-6). Thus the channel-choice event has positive probability and its elapsed time is finite almost surely.
source_pointers: Anderson-Cappelletti-Kim-Nguyen, Definition 3.2 and Example 3.2, arXiv HTML lines 140-151 and 198-209; same falling-factorial CTMC convention at lines 121-133.
Xu, On the Regularity of Reaction Systems, arXiv v2 lines 110-115 restates the same witness and its stochastic explosion.
claims.novelty_boundary: The underlying strongly endotactic transient/explosive counterexamples are established prior work. The closed-class description and finite-cap estimate are independent reconstructions; no novelty or priority claim is made.
claims.costs: Four reactions, two species, fixed positive rates. The highest reactant molecularity is ten. Exact arithmetic for a finite prefix and a rational angular sweep is local CPU only; no experiment or SSA trajectory was acquired.
claims.falsifier: A proof that the prescribed event has zero probability or infinite conditional clock would invalidate this reconstruction; the primary source independently gives the same positive-product/summable-time proof. A generator-level model with measured propensities departing from the stated factorial law is a different model.
claims.next_gate: Independent review of the class macro argument and finite-cap conditional-time inequality; for any physical use, specify and measure a staged or resource-limited implementation and recheck its generator.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For unit rates and V=1, starting at (3,0), the prescribed runaway event has probability P_infty>0. The exact product through levels 3,...,99 and exact telescoping tail competitor-ratio sum from n=100 give the certified rational bound P_infty>0.346709327029.
claims.proof_path: check_endotactic_explosion.py computes the exact rational prefix and tail sum 27506776741/1260593928000; log(1+q)<=q and exp(-Q)>=1-Q give the product lower bound. CHECK_OUTPUT.json contains the exact numerator/denominator and decimal display.
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a scoped exact numerical sharpening of a known existence proof. Novelty is unknown and unclaimed.
claims.costs: One Python exact-rational run; no stochastic simulation. Prefix product is 97 cycles (291 intended jumps); the remaining tail is bounded analytically.
claims.falsifier: An arithmetic error in any rational propensity, prefix factor, or telescoping tail identity; rerunning the included script and parsing CHECK_OUTPUT.json reproduces the calculation.
claims.next_gate: A fresh exact-algebra audit by a reviewer, followed by a confidence-calibrated finite-cap simulation only if the idealized model is of practical interest.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For the unit-rate, V=1 network, modify the CTMC by blocking any reaction leaving D_M={(a,b):a+b<=M}. This is a finite-state nonexplosive CTMC. For every M>=107, the probability of hitting (M-7,0) by time T=44401/43200 is at least 0.1733546635 under the specified hard-cap convention.
claims.proof_path: Along each selected pump cycle beginning at (n,0), the maximum total count is n+8; the cap therefore leaves the selected route to N=M-7 intact. Route probability is bounded below by the exact P_infty lower bound. Conditional route time has mean at most S=44401/86400; Markov's inequality at 2S gives conditional probability at least 1/2 of reaching N by T.
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a model-specific finite-size consequence of a known runaway path; it is not a claim about natural chemistry or priority.
claims.costs: The cap adds an explicit boundary rule; the lower bound assumes all outward jumps are blocked and all interior propensities remain unmodified. Only rational arithmetic was run.
claims.falsifier: In a capped simulation or physical emulation matching the generator and boundary rule, a statistically reliable hit probability below this bound at the stated start, M, and horizon contradicts the ideal model assumptions or the derivation.
claims.next_gate: If pursued empirically, calibrate all propensities, exact count capacity, and time-homogeneity, then compare event-path and uncapped-rate records against a direct Gillespie implementation.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: Under standard volume-scaled stochastic mass action lambda_r^V(z)=kappa_r V^(1-|y_r|)z_under_y, for every fixed V>0 the same class and prescribed route remain explosive with positive probability. The conditional route time is bounded by S_V=V/(2kappa_1)+V^4/(72kappa_2)+V^9/(86400kappa_3). For fixed starting count n=3, the probability of the first selected cycle is Theta(V^-17) as V tends to infinity with rate constants fixed.
claims.proof_path: Scale each desired and competing stage rate by V^(1-|y|). The asymptotic n-orders at fixed V are unchanged, so the infinite product and inverse-rate series remain finite. At n=3 and large V, stage success factors scale as V^-2, V^-5, and V^-10. This bounds the canonical runaway path probability, not the total explosion probability.
claims.novelty_boundary: The finite-volume continuation is an internal extension of the known witness. It does not claim a thermodynamic-limit explosion probability or a fixed-concentration counterexample.
claims.costs: Volume scaling is an explicit model convention. S_V is an analytic conditional-clock bound; no data were acquired.
claims.falsifier: Changing the volume convention changes the displayed factors and requires recomputation. The assertion is falsified if any fixed-V canonical stage factor is zero or if the inverse desired-rate sum diverges.
claims.next_gate: Analyze total explosion probability and first-passage scaling under an explicit physical cutoff; do not infer those from the canonical path alone.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: Xu's Theorem 3.6 gives a sufficient nonexplosion condition: there is u>0 such that every reaction with u dot (y'-y)>0 has propensity O(||x||_1). Xu also states all second-order endotactic mass-action systems are nonexplosive. Anderson-Cappelletti-Kim-Nguyen's Theorem 7.2 gives positive recurrence on each closed irreducible class after adding its specified high-order species drains to a strongly endotactic network. These are sufficient neighboring classes, not maximal or necessary-and-sufficient characterizations.
claims.proof_path: See FINAL_REPORT.md section 'Volume scaling and physical boundary' and primary source theorem statements. Xu uses a positive linear Lyapunov function for regularity; Anderson et al. prove a proper Foster-Lyapunov drift after drain additions.
source_pointers: Xu Theorem 3.6, lines 150-164; abstract and scope at lines 34-37.
Anderson et al. Corollary 7.1 and Theorem 7.2, arXiv HTML lines 1116-1153.
claims.novelty_boundary: Both theorem families are established primary literature; they are not consequences of N33/N76 and are not newly claimed here.
claims.costs: The drain theorem changes the network by adding reactions; the nonexplosion condition requires checking a positive direction and growth bounds. Neither condition alone gives a broad unmodified all-endotactic recurrence theorem.
claims.falsifier: A mismatch between the stated source theorem assumptions and the report summary; see the cited primary theorem ranges.
claims.next_gate: For a positive recurrence theorem, test the exact added-drain hypotheses or supply a new classwise physical-time Foster function. No maximal valid class is claimed.
